value.rationale: A natural covariance interpolation quantity, the least cyclic Gram eigenvalue, has an exact two-parity sharp N^{-1} law. The theorem distinguishes invertibility from singularity on even vs odd grids, classifies every finite-grid rank, and gives a strict kernel criterion for arbitrary distinct circle points. This goes beyond restating cone preservation or a numerical example.
